selection_rationale: Approach D incorporates domain-appropriate illumination, contrast, and synthetic canopy shadow augmentation. While matching Approach C on UFPR04 (0.9177 vs 0.9179 macro-F1), it achieves a decisive +8.92% macro-F1 gain on UFPR05 (0.7895 vs 0.7003) and raises free recall from 43.70% to 59.10%, producing the highest cross-domain generalization average across all unseen lots.
